title: AI Tools and Policies
text:
Not all AI tools are equal from an institutional standpoint — the difference between an approved tool and a merely popular one is contractual guarantees: that submitted data isn't used to train other models, and that the provider meets applicable privacy law.

A personal account on a free tool carries none of those guarantees.

The rule that matters: always use the corporate license when one exists, never a personal account for teaching or institutional data — and two policies, on responsible AI use and on assessment, govern how all of this applies.
